scripts.prisma:seed: docker exec -it g4pl-backend pnpm exec prisma db seed
scripts.prisma:migrate: docker exec -it g4pl-backend pnpm exec prisma migrate dev --schema=../../shared/prisma/schema.prisma --name
scripts.prisma:apply: docker exec -it g4pl-backend pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy --schema=../../shared/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:generate: docker exec -it g4pl-backend pnpm exec prisma generate --schema=../../shared/prisma/schema.prisma
